businessGoal: To allow visitors to send messages for support and inquiries.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is displayed when navigating to the contact page.
Verify that all required fields are shown in the contact form.
Verify that the subject dropdown includes all specified options.
Verify that a validation error is shown when the message is fewer than 50 characters.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission of the contact form.
